paite: Thutut zuau na genzak ding ahi kei. Theihpih diklou hi ding in migiloute toh na kizop ding ahi kei.
heading: Dikna Leh Hoihna
english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

paite: Gilou hih ding in mipi na zui ding ahi kei. Vaihawmna kaikawi ding in mi tam lamlam zui in amau na gum ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

paite: Thubuai genna ah mizawng dou in guptuam na nei ding ahi kei.
english: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

paite: Na melma bawngtal hiam sabiltung hiam taimang na tuahleh, akiang a na pi nawn ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

paite: Nang hon homi' sabiltung, avan puak lel a puk na muhleh taisan lou a, na panpih ngeingei ding ahi.
english: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

paite: Thubuai a kihekna ah mizawngte a ding in thukhenna na kaikawi ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

paite: Thil diklou a pan gamlapi ah om in, thil hihkhial lou leh midikte that ke'n; migiloute siamtangsak lou ding ka hih ziak in.
english: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

paite: Golhgukna na la ding ahi kei. Golhgukna in mit atosak a, midiktatte thu akaikawi ngal hi.
english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

paite: Huai lou in mikhual na hihgenthei ding ahi kei. Mikhual lungtang na theih ziak in, Aigupta gam ah mikhual in na om ngeita uh, chih thei in.
english: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

paite: Kum guk sung na gam ah haichi na tuh dia, agahte na lakhawm ding,
heading: Akum Sagihna Leh Ani Sagihna
english: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

paite: himahleh akum sagihna na omsak kinken a, na khawlsak ding ahi; na mite lak a mizawngte'n anektheihna ding un. Anutsiat peuh uh gamlak sate'n ane ding uhi. Huchibang mah in na grephuan leh na olive huan tung ah na hih ding uhi.
english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

paite: Ni guk sung nangmah nna na sem dia, ani sagih ni in na khawl ding; na bawngtal leh na sabiltung akhawl ua, na sikhanu tapa leh mikhual ahalhtheihna ding un.
english: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

paite: Na kiang a ka gen tengteng zui ding in pilvang inla; pathian dangte min lou ke'n, na kam a pan zak in leng om kei hen.
english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

paite: Kum khat sung in ka kiang ah ankuangluina thumvei na bawl ding ahi.
heading: Ankuangluina Thupi Thumte / (Eks 34.18-26; Diu 16.1-17)
english: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

paite: Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina bawl in ka hon thupiak bang in, Abib kha a hun sehsa in, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding ahi, huai ni a Aigupta a pan hong paikhia na hih ziak in. Ka ma a kuamah khutvuak a ahong kilat ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

paite: Pawltak Ankuanglui, na sepgim gahte, lou a na tuh Puaklutna Ankuangluina na bawl ding ahi. Na lou a pan na sepgimna gahte na puaklut khit chiang in kum tawp ah, Puaklut Ankuanglui na bawl ding ahi.
english: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

paite: Kum khat sung in thumvei pasal tengteng Toupa PATHIAN ma a akilat ding uh ahi.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Ka kithoihna sisan, tanghou silngou soh toh na lat ding ahi kei. Ka kithoihna thau a zingsang chiang tan in a-om ding leng ahi kei hi,
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian inn a na gam gah masa hoihpente lak a masapen na laklut ding ahi. Kelnou, api nawitui in na huan ding ahi kei.
english: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

paite: Ngai in, lampi a nang hon kem ding leh ka mun bawlsa a nang hon tun ding in na ma ah Angel khat ka sawl hi.
heading: Thuchiamte Leh Thuhilhte
english: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

paite: Ama ah pilvang inla, a-aw zui in hehsak ke'n; na tatleknate angaihdam louh ding ziak in, ka min lah amah ah a-om ngal a.
english: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

paite: Himahleh a-aw na zuih taktak a, ka gen tengteng na hihleh; na melmate tung ah melma ka hi dia, nang hon doute tung ah doumi ka hi ding hi.
english: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.

paite: Na ma ah ka Angel pai ding ahi, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Kanaante, Hivte leh Jebuste lak ah nang ahon pilut ding hi; huchi in amaute ka satkhe ding hi.
english: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

paite: Apathiante uh ma ah na kun ding ahi kei. A-nna uh leng na sem ding ahi sam kei. Athilhihte bang uh leng na hih ding uh ahi kei. Himahleh amaute na zou siang sipsip dia, amilimte uh na hihzan dimdem ding ahi.
english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh nna na sem ding ua, ama'n na annek-tuidawn uh avualzawl ding hi. Huchi in na lak ua pan chinatna ka lamang ding hi.
english: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

paite: Kuamah nausia a-om kei dia, na gamsung uah kuamah aching kei ding. Na nite zah uh ka tangtungsak ding hi.
english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

paite: Na ma uah kei lauhna ka sawl dia, na hong tunna mi tengteng lak ah buaizakna ka omsak ding hi. Huchi in na melma tengteng nang a pan ka taikeksak ding hi.
english: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

paite: Na ma ah khuaizanta ka sawl dia, huai in Hivte, Kanaante leh Hitte na ma a pan ahawlkhe ding hi.
english: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

paite: Kum khat sung in amaute na ma a pan ka hawlkhe kei ding. Agam ahong vuak dia, noute hon hihse ding in gamsa ahong pung kha ding hi.
english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

paite: Na hong pun ua, gam na luah mateng, na ma ua pan amaute tawm khakha in ka hawlkhe ding hi.
english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

paite: Tuipi San a pan Philistiate tuipi pha hial in, gamdai a pan Lui chiang pha in na gamgi ka khung ding. Na khut ua agam luah mite ka hon piakkhiak ding ziak in na ma uah amaute na hawlkhe ding uhi.
english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

paite: Amaute toh hiam apathiante uh toh hiam leng thukhun na bawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

paite: Na gamsung uah ateng ding uh ahi kei. Ka tung ah nang ahon khialsak kha ding uhi. Apathiante uh nna na sep uleh huaite nou a ding in thang ahi ding hi.
english: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
